title: 皇后渡口大橋
summary: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。
summaryEn: The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」與「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system" and "Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中塔塔頂」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Central tower head” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。若只靠中塔自身的彎曲勁度抵抗，塔必須非常粗大。皇后渡口大橋的解法是讓三座塔的斜索在兩個主跨的跨中互相交叉重疊，相鄰塔的斜索彼此牽制，使中塔頂端的位移受到相鄰塔與橋面的約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中塔塔頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft. Resisting this by the central tower’s own bending stiffness alone would demand a massive tower. The Queensferry solution is to let stays from adjacent towers cross and overlap at mid-span of both main spans, so neighbouring towers restrain each other and the central tower head is held by the adjacent towers and the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Central tower head” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中塔塔頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Central tower head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題
knowledge.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system
knowledge.text: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。三塔斜張橋的中塔兩側都是 650 m 的主跨，沒有固定的背跨可以錨索：當活載只作用在其中一跨時，那一跨下垂，中塔被拉向該側，另一跨上拱，結構整體變得很柔。
knowledge.textEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. In a three-tower bridge the central tower has a 650 m main span on both sides and no fixed back span to anchor to: when live load occupies only one span, that span sags, the central tower is pulled toward it, the other span rises and the whole structure is soft.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system" is correct?
options: 三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。
兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。
斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。
optionsEn: A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones.
In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly.
The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head.
quiz.explanation: 兩塔斜張橋的每座塔都有一側背跨，背索錨在靠近橋台、由許多橋墩支撐的背跨上，塔頂因此被牢牢拉住。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a two-tower cable-stayed bridge each tower has a back span, and its back stays are anchored near the abutment on a span supported by many piers, so the tower head is held firmly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中塔塔頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Central tower head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。若無交叉索，塔頂等效勁度 k = 20 MN/m，位移 δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m；交叉索使 k 提高到 60 MN/m 時，δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m，降為三分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Without crossing stays, with an equivalent head stiffness k = 20 MN/m, the displacement is δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m; if crossing stays raise k to 60 MN/m, δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m, one-third as much. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。若無交叉索，塔頂等效勁度 k = 20 MN/m，位移 δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m；交叉索使 k 提高到 60 MN/m 時，δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m，降為三分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Without crossing stays, with an equivalent head stiffness k = 20 MN/m, the displacement is δ = 30/20 = 1.5 m; if crossing stays raise k to 60 MN/m, δ = 30/60 = 0.5 m, one-third as much. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system", which statement holds?
options: 沉箱抽乾後內部就是乾地，封底混凝土只要有就好，厚度不重要。
每個主跨的合龍可以分開計畫，互不影響。
中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。
optionsEn: Once a caisson is pumped dry it is simply dry ground, so the seal’s thickness hardly matters.
Each main-span closure can be planned separately without affecting the other.
Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN.
quiz.explanation: 中塔頂在單跨活載下的水平不平衡力 H = 30 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load on one span, the central tower head sees an unbalanced horizontal force H = 30 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中塔塔頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Central tower head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：多塔斜張橋的設計基準要明列單跨加載、棋盤式加載與不對稱風載等工況，並把中塔頂位移列為主要使用性指標；結構體系比選報告應比較交叉索、加勁中塔與穩定索等方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for a multi-tower bridge should list single-span, alternate-span and unbalanced wind cases and make central-tower displacement a key serviceability indicator; the system study should compare crossing stays, a stiffened central tower and stabilising cables.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若中塔勁度不足又沒有交叉索或其他穩定措施，單跨重車隊或不對稱風載會使中塔大幅偏擺，主跨撓度與塔底彎矩超出設計，伸縮縫與鋪面受損；斜索力在兩跨之間大幅來回轉移也會加速疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A central tower lacking stiffness, with no crossing stays or other stabilisation, sways heavily under a heavy convoy on one span or unbalanced wind, pushing deflections and tower-base moments beyond design and damaging joints and surfacing; large back-and-forth shifts of stay force between spans also accelerate fatigue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 多塔斜張橋的設計基準要明列單跨加載、棋盤式加載與不對稱風載等工況，並把中塔頂位移列為主要使用性指標；結構體系比選報告應比較交叉索、加勁中塔與穩定索等方案。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis for a multi-tower bridge should list single-span, alternate-span and unbalanced wind cases and make central-tower displacement a key serviceability indicator; the system study should compare crossing stays, a stiffened central tower and stabilising cables.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三塔體系的中塔穩定問題」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system"?
options: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
監測系統感測器越多，就越能自動判斷結構是否安全，不需要工程師解讀。
optionsEn: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
More sensors let a monitoring system judge safety automatically without engineering interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 以全橋模型比較有無交叉索、不同重疊長度時的塔頂位移、跨中撓度與塔底彎矩，確定交叉段長度；成橋後以載重試驗只加載一個主跨，量測中塔頂位移與兩跨撓度，與模型預測比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare tower-head displacement, mid-span deflection and tower-base moment with and without crossing stays and for different overlap lengths in a global model to fix the crossing length; after completion load one main span only in a load test and compare measured central-tower displacement and deflections of both spans with predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三塔體系的中塔穩定問題：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stabilising the central tower of a three-tower system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中塔塔頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Central tower head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若中塔勁度不足又沒有交叉索或其他穩定措施，單跨重車隊或不對稱風載會使中塔大幅偏擺，主跨撓度與塔底彎矩超出設計，伸縮縫與鋪面受損；斜索力在兩跨之間大幅來回轉移也會加速疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A central tower lacking stiffness, with no crossing stays or other stabilisation, sways heavily under a heavy convoy on one span or unbalanced wind, pushing deflections and tower-base moments beyond design and damaging joints and surfacing; large back-and-forth shifts of stay force between spans also accelerate fatigue. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：皇后渡口大橋的解法是讓三座塔的斜索在兩個主跨的跨中互相交叉重疊，相鄰塔的斜索彼此牽制，使中塔頂端的位移受到相鄰塔與橋面的約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Queensferry solution is to let stays from adjacent towers cross and overlap at mid-span of both main spans, so neighbouring towers restrain each other and the central tower head is held by the adjacent towers and the deck.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三塔斜張橋只是兩座兩塔橋接在一起，中塔的受力和邊塔一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges joined, and the central tower behaves like the outer ones." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中交叉斜索」如何影響皇后渡口大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mid-span crossing stays” governs force, deformation or durability in “Queensferry Crossing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 交叉斜索的作用像一條條斜向的彈簧：當中塔被拉向一側時，從相鄰塔伸到跨中、並錨在重疊區的斜索會被拉長，產生反向的水平分力，把中塔與橋面拉回。每根斜索提供的水平勁度與鋼截面積、彈性模數成正比，與索長成反比，並乘上水平夾角餘弦的平方，所以較平、較短的索效率較好。重疊段越長，參與牽制的索越多，但同一段橋面上兩組斜索的錨固點也越密集，增加錨固與檢修的複雜度。設計者以全橋分析在勁度與構造之間取得平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中交叉斜索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing stays act like inclined springs: when the central tower is pulled to one side, stays from the adjacent tower reaching into the overlap zone at mid-span are stretched and produce an opposing horizontal component that pulls the tower and deck back. Each stay’s horizontal stiffness is proportional to its steel area and modulus, inversely proportional to its length, and multiplied by the square of the cosine of its angle, so flatter and shorter stays are more effective. A longer overlap brings more stays into play but crowds two sets of anchorages on the same stretch of deck, complicating anchorage and maintenance. Designers balance stiffness against detailing with global analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mid-span crossing stays” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單索水平勁度 k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜索越長，對塔頂的約束勁度就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The longer a stay, the more stiffness it gives the tower head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中交叉斜索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mid-span crossing stays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中交叉斜索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mid-span crossing stays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單索水平勁度 k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L。取 E = 195 GPa、A = 75 股×150 mm² = 11,250 mm²、θ = 20°（cos²θ ≈ 0.883）、L = 400 m：k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m。16 根交叉索合計約 77 MN/m，若橋面柔性使有效率只有 50%，增加約 39 MN/m，使單元 1 的 20 MN/m 提高到約 59 MN/m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Single-stay horizontal stiffness k_h = E·A·cos²θ/L. With E = 195 GPa, A = 75 strands×150 mm² = 11,250 mm², θ = 20° (cos²θ ≈ 0.883) and L = 400 m, k_h ≈ 195,000×11,250×0.883/400,000 ≈ 4,840 N/mm ≈ 4.8 MN/m. Sixteen crossing stays total about 77 MN/m; if deck flexibility makes them only 50% effective, they add about 39 MN/m, raising unit 1’s 20 MN/m to about 59 MN/m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中交叉斜索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mid-span crossing stays” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以參數分析檢驗重疊長度、索截面與索力對中塔頂位移的敏感度；施工完成後量測交叉區各索的索力與錨點高程，確認兩組斜索的力量分配符合設計，並記錄作為監測基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run parametric studies of how overlap length, stay section and force affect central-tower displacement; after construction measure the forces and anchor levels of stays in the crossing zone to confirm the force split between the two sets matches the design, and record them as the monitoring baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交叉區的錨固細部要以局部模型與疲勞評估確認，並為兩組斜索各自保留檢修與更換空間；索力驗收表應把交叉索列為獨立一組，容許偏差可比一般索更嚴格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify crossing-zone anchorage details with local models and fatigue assessment and keep access and replacement space for both sets of stays; list crossing stays as a separate group in the force acceptance table, possibly with tighter tolerances than other stays.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。
knowledge.textEn: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交叉斜索的軸向勁度與重疊長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axial stiffness and overlap length of crossing stays" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
組合橋面中混凝土只是路面，不參與斜張橋的整體受力。
若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
In a composite deck the concrete is just a road surface and takes no part in the global cable-stayed action.
Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking.
quiz.explanation: 若交叉區兩組斜索的錨固點與鋼梁細部設計不當，重疊段的橋面承受高度集中的局部力，焊道與錨箱易生疲勞裂縫；交叉索若索力偏低，等效勁度下降，中塔在不對稱荷載下的位移增大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor anchorage and girder details where two sets of stays overlap concentrate local forces in the deck there, making welds and anchor boxes prone to fatigue cracking; crossing stays with low force lose effective stiffness and the central tower moves more under unbalanced load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
